extracted.intended_audience: journalists, science writers, broadcasters and media producers interested in ESO press coverage and media visits
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance from the European Southern Observatory on what their press releases cover, how and when they are distributed (including embargo rules), how journalists can subscribe and apply for media visits, and the terms for using ESO images and videos.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of ESO press releases
rubrics_metrics.description: "ESO press releases highlight exciting scientific discoveries done with ESO telescopes, astronomical images with broad public appeal or important organisational news. The goal of these press releases is to share exciting discoveries and the beauty of the Universe with the general public."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press releases are distinct from announcements (which highlight news and information of interest to astronomers and enthusiasts) and Pictures of the Week (showcasing photographs). Press releases are produced to help journalists prepare public-facing stories and provide less technical text, quotes from scientists, and rich images and video.

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages and local contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: "ESO press releases are provided in multiple languages, including all languages of ESO members, host and partner states, courtesy of the ESO Science Outreach Network (ESON)."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ESON members also serve as local contacts for the media. Press releases and other news items may be offered in the subscriber's choice of language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargo / advance-notice policy
rubrics_metrics.description: "ESO press releases are sent to media representatives subscribed to our Media Newsletter, under embargo (when applicable) usually 48 hours in advance of their public release, giving them access to the full press release text and associated multimedia."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wherever possible ESO issues a release at (or close to) the same time as the paper’s publication in an academic journal. Some releases may be sent 'For Immediate Release' or at different times with specific embargo conditions. ESO considers that its press package (less technical text, quotes, images/video) provides significant added value over the academic paper alone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargo breach policy and consequences
rubrics_metrics.description: "If a journalist publishes a story using the material from our press release package (for example, quotes, additional information, or associated multimedia) before the advance notice period ends, we consider this breaking the embargo conditions."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In most cases, if the article in breach is not removed immediately, ESO will remove the journalist from the Media Newsletter mailing list without further notice and add them to the public newsletter(s) that deliver news at the time of public release, without priority access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Newsletter subscription eligibility and verification
rubrics_metrics.description: "To start receiving our news items for the media, please fill in our press subscription form. Subscribed journalists and other bona-fide members of the media receive press releases under embargo... We reserve the right to check the correctness of the information and grant access only to those that provide accurate information."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bona fide members of the press, as well as broadcasters, may sign up and choose English or a local language. The newsletter also contains pictures of the week, announcements and video materials useful to media representatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of ESO communications (announcements and Pictures of the Week)
rubrics_metrics.description: "ESO also publishes announcements and pictures of the week on its website. Announcements highlight news and information about ESO of interest to astronomers, astronomer enthusiasts, and the wider public. Pictures of the week... showcase beautiful photographs of ESO observatories or stunning images taken with ESO telescopes."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use announcements for more technical or specialist news aimed at astronomers/enthusiasts; pictures of the week are curated photographic features distinct from formal press releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media visits: standard and strategic visits
rubrics_metrics.description: "ESO welcomes journalists, science writers and producers interested in visiting the observatory sites in Chile for production of news stories, documentaries, photo books and other projects... In addition to the standard media visits, which are organised on a per-request basis and are tailored to the needs of individual media visitors, ESO also organises strategic media visits."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strategic media visits are guided group visits of accredited journalists in ESO member and partner states to ESO sites, take place on fixed dates, and travel costs are partly covered by ESO. For details and how to apply, refer to the media visits page or contact contacto@eso.org. Media visits to ESO Headquarters in Garching can be arranged via press@eso.org.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image and video library availability and technical formats
rubrics_metrics.description: "The image gallery is a collection of photographs, images and illustrations... A range of image qualities and formats is available, including the files in the highest resolution available. ESO's expansive video library includes a variety of videos... Most videos are available in HD (720/50p) or ultra HD, but please refer to the video formats page for detailed technical information about the video file types available."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Journalists should consult the video formats page for technical details and broadcast-ready formats. There are also specific video news reels and compilations for broadcast use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image and motion-picture use and crediting
rubrics_metrics.description: "ESO images and motion pictures may be reproduced on a non-exclusive basis without fee so long as ESO is clearly credited as the source of the video material. Please consult the copyright notice for full terms of use."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Credit ESO clearly as the source; check the full copyright notice for any additional restrictions or attribution requirements. Embedded third-party content (e.g., YouTube) may have separate terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of publicly available scientific material
rubrics_metrics.description: "We recognise that material that is already public (for example, abstracts, online preprints, published papers) is fair game for journalists."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ESO nonetheless considers its press release package to provide significant added value (less technical text, scientist quotes, images/video). Journalists are free to use publicly available materials, but embargo rules apply to ESO's press package when issued under embargo.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact points and help for media
rubrics_metrics.description: "For more information, please contact the ESO Media Manager Bárbara Ferreira at press@eso.org. If you have questions about media visits contact contacto@eso.org."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these contacts to request press releases, arrange media visits, ask for images or technical specifications, or clarify embargo and subscription questions.
